verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Lithic handles several program-management functions (KYC bypass, authorization rules at program/account/card levels, disputes/chargeback filing, spend limits) that reduce the founder's compliance burden, but there is no explicit mention of BIN sponsorship or bank/network membership being abstracted away, and no documented timeline from signup to first live card. Missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership claims, a documented onboarding timeline, and independent confirmation of speed-to-launch.
